options.name: checksum_algorithm
options.description: Algorithm to determine checksum of file. Will throw an error if the host is unable to use specified algorithm.

options.name: follow
options.description: Whether to follow symlinks or junction points. In the case of C(path) pointing to another link, then that will be followed until no more links are found.

options.name: get_checksum
options.description: Whether to return a checksum of the file (default sha1)

options.name: get_size
options.description: Whether to return the size of a file or directory.

options.name: path
options.description: The full path of the file/object to get the facts of; both forward and back slashes are accepted.
